_about: Synthetic sample data for Assessment & Report Cards screens (OBJ-19, with OBJ-15 class and OBJ-03 enrolment). Everyone and every mark is invented. Scheme weights, grade bands, appeal windows, promotion rules and exam dates come from the GIIS Student Handbook 2025-26 (HB) and the GIIS SG Exam Schedule 2026-27 and are GIIS Singapore's own settings, not group defaults (DL-22, DL-59 pattern). OWIS values are synthetic (OQ-103). Viewer Meera Joshi, Academic Coordinator CBSE Grades 6-8, SG-PGL; 'today' 15 Nov 2026. Dates follow the Exam Schedule (AY 2026-27 assessments from 19 May 2026 to 19 Mar 2027). Academic years are per campus x programme offering (DL-96): GIIS SG CBSE starts in April, IB DP at SG-ECS in July. Fee status never appears here (DL-83). Reuses the 7B roster from classes-sample.json.
